designFindings: The old crons hide pre-v4 coupling. Three jobs (settlement recovery, scheduled sends, settle from indexer) register only when CAPXUL_PAYMENTS_V2_ADDRESS is set (packages/backend/src/platform/jobs.ts:87-112). On a v4-only deployment, dated-payment sending and indexer settlement sweeps are not scheduled by this path at all.

Door bypass is total: the backend has 0 non-test imports from any `#<concept>` door, while test files do use the doors (e.g. requests/receivables/tests/notify.test.ts imports from #requests). This happens even though package.json maps every door and ADR-0042 decision 1 requires the door.

The proof evidence is shaped in a misleading way. A multi-command step records durationMs for the whole step but names only the last command (apps/docs/factory/proofs/*.json, surfaces.cli.command). Any per-command latency taken from proofs is wrong for 955 samples.
Runtime-added tokens have no Ponder source (jobs.ts:135-139, ADR-0042), so a Convex-side scanner duplicates indexer work. The new stack must solve this in the indexer or keep a cron.
A protocol row factory (seatPermissionChange, protocol/src/organizations/operations.ts:168-171) defeats grep-based row inventories. Any generator that walks `Operation.*("name"` misses 2 rows.
result.notes: I checked 78 claims against /home/user/factory at 0d2be303e and the specs and book sources in capxul-next. Most counts reproduce exactly. That includes the 348 SDK methods, 164 named, 184 orphans and their group sizes, 117 unreached rows, the 215 operations and their version tags, the 81 designed blocks with 73 who and 63 refusal differences, and the 161/35/19 funnel. Also correct: 52/163 event sources, 2/1/0 spans for 164/27/24 operations, 27 backend overrides, 109 events (9 ui, 23 generic transitions, 16 without a producer), 18 span sites, 442 internal-operation files, 37/12/34 plumbing files, 452/402 InTx imports, the settlement lines 143-146, the bookFacts and moneyFactId key, the 5 deep-path callers, the indexer's auth.ts and polling lines, the 800 ms CPU start-up gate, the staging baseline figures, the 13 null branches, 100/91/24 tags, 1,377 v4 proofs and 35 exemptions. The owner-key shape counts agree within 1 or 2 (parser noise), so I left them. Per-command p50s also reproduce: schema 581, use env 604, allowance create 17,070, org create 15,886, ceiling freeze 17,771, bank settle 4,838. All ten policies keep four real options, a grade per criterion, a recommendation and evidence with paths. The most important fixes are to P3 (the cron inventory and plan), P5 (per-command chain-read tails taken from multi-command steps), P4 (the missing ADR-0042 ruling and a duplicate rule) and P9 (the plan would have deleted 2 v4 claims).
